scripts.build:all: npm run build:api && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:go && node --test tests/deployment-config.test.mjs && node scripts/run-browser-integration.mjs preview && node scripts/run-browser-integration.mjs production --grep "preview fixture is available only in the preview environment"
scripts.db:preview:local: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-state && wrangler d1 migrations apply DELETION_DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-state && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-state --file=./db/seed-preview.sql
scripts.db:preview: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview --require-real-id && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply DELETION_DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview --remote && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview --remote --file=./db/seed-preview.sql
scripts.db:production: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs production --require-real-id && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env production --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply DELETION_DB --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:api:preview: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview --require-real-id && npm run build:api && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:api:production: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs production --require-real-id && npm run build:api && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.api.jsonc --env production
scripts.deploy:pages:preview: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview --require-real-id && node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name turnocerto --branch preview
scripts.deploy:pages:production: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs production --require-real-id && node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --config wrangler.jsonc --project-name turnocerto --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview --require-real-id && node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && npm run deploy:api:preview && npm run deploy:pages:preview
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs production --require-real-id && node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && npm run deploy:api:production && npm run deploy:pages:production
